# NEW 2026-11-22 v12.0 Wave 7 Worker 1 Slot 94: Eurasian Concert, Neutral Buffer Land Ownership & 12 Native IO Voting Resolutions (oe_con_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_v120_concert_resolutions.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# ==============================================================================
# GROUP A: ROMAN WORLD ORDER (oe_byz_roman_world — 4 resolutions, 0 override)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Pax Romana Truce Arbitration
oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration = {
	international_organization_type = oe_byz_roman_world
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_ROMAN_LEADER"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_roman_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration_cd years = 10 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_pax_romana_truces
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_con_pax_romana_mod
						years = 10
						mode = replace
					}
					save_scope_as = oe_con_pax_a
					scope:recipient = {
						every_international_organization_member = {
							limit = {
								is_rebel_country = no
								num_locations > 0
								NOT = { this = scope:oe_con_pax_a }
								NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_con_pax_a }
								NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:oe_con_pax_a }
								NOT = { has_truce_with = scope:oe_con_pax_a }
								OR = {
									is_rival_of = scope:oe_con_pax_a
									is_enemy_of = scope:oe_con_pax_a
									opinion = { target = scope:oe_con_pax_a value < 0 }
								}
							}
							add_truce_with = {
								target = scope:oe_con_pax_a
								years = 8
								mutual = yes
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_pax_romana_arbitration_cd years = 5 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 10
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						AND = {
							is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
							at_war = yes
						}
						war_exhaustion >= 3
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_LEADER_CRISIS"
					value = 40
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_subject = yes
					at_war = no
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_BELLIGERENT_SUBJ"
					value = -15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 2. Imperial Joint Embargo (strictly uses can_add_relation + create_relation embargo_nation, NEVER add_embargo!)
oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo = {
	international_organization_type = oe_byz_roman_world
	show_target_in_tooltip = yes
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_ROMAN_LEADER"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_roman_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_con_select_embargo_target"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_con_no_embargo_target"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			num_locations > 0
			num_of_ports > 0
			NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
			OR = {
				NOT = { exists = scope:actor }
				scope:actor ?= {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
					NOT = { is_subject_of = root }
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo }
					"active_resolution(resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo)" ?= {
						"resolution_target(target)" = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo_cd years = 10 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_joint_embargo
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:target
					scope:target = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					every_international_organization_member = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							num_locations > 0
							NOT = { this = scope:target }
							NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
							NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
							can_add_relation = {
								first = this
								second = scope:target
								type = relation_type:embargo_nation
							}
							NOT = {
								giving_scripted_relation = {
									type = relation_type:embargo_nation
									target = scope:target
								}
							}
						}
						create_relation = {
							first = this
							second = scope:target
							type = relation_type:embargo_nation
							years = 10
						}
					}
					leader_country ?= {
						add_country_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_con_imperial_embargo_mod
							years = 10
							mode = replace
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_imperial_joint_embargo_cd years = 5 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = -5
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_rival_of = scope:target
							is_enemy_of = scope:target
							is_at_war_with = scope:target
							opinion = { target = scope:target value < -25 }
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "OE_CON_AI_TARGET_HOSTILE"
						value = 45
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_allied_with = { target = scope:target }
							is_subject_of = scope:target
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "OE_CON_AI_TARGET_ALLY"
						value = -100
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 3. Ecumenical Defense Mobilization
oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy = {
	international_organization_type = oe_byz_roman_world
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy_cd }
				OR = {
					total_members >= 3
					any_international_organization_member = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						at_war = yes
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_ROMAN_LEADER"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_roman_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy_cd years = 12 }
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_ecumenical_defense_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.2
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_ecumenical_defense_levy_cd years = 5 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						at_war = yes
						any_neighbor_country = {
							is_rival_of = scope:actor
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_WARTIME_DEFENSE"
					value = 60
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					at_war = no
					num_loans >= 3
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_PEACETIME_DEBT"
					value = -35
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 4. Frontier Incorporation into the Roman Oikoumene
oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction = {
	international_organization_type = oe_byz_roman_world
	show_target_in_tooltip = yes
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction
			}
			international_organization:oe_byz_roman_world = {
				NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction_cd }
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_ROMAN_LEADER"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_roman_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_byz_roman_world
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = location
		target_flag = target
		interaction_source_list = {
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
					every_owned_location = {
						limit = {
							oe_con_is_valid_roman_frontier_loc = yes
						}
						add_to_list = source
					}
				}
			}
		}
		name = "oe_con_select_frontier_location"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_con_no_frontier_location"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			oe_con_is_valid_roman_frontier_loc = yes
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction }
					"active_resolution(resolution:oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction)" ?= {
						"resolution_target(target)" = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction_cd years = 8 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_frontier_incorp
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:target
					scope:target = {
						is_land = yes
						is_passable = yes
						has_owner = yes
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					add_location_to_international_organization = scope:target
				}
				scope:target.owner ?= {
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_con_roman_limes_charter_mod
						years = 15
						mode = replace
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					every_international_organization_member = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							is_ai = no
						}
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.3
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_roman_frontier_jurisdiction_cd years = 4 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 5
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
						AND = {
							exists = scope:target
							scope:target = {
								has_owner = yes
								owner ?= scope:actor
							}
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_FRONTIER_STAKE"
					value = 50
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# ==============================================================================
# GROUP B: MIDDLE KINGDOM (middle_kingdom — 4 purely additive resolutions, 0 override!)
# ==============================================================================

# 5. Kanhe Tribute Reassessment
oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:celestial_governor
							international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_EMPEROR"
				value = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:celestial_governor
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_GOV"
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_celestial_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment_cd years = 10 }
			leader_country ?= {
				save_scope_as = oe_con_mk_emp
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_kanhe_emperor_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
				change_celestial_authority = { value = 5 }
			}
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_kanhe_tributary_mod
					years = 10
					mode = replace
				}
				if = {
					limit = { exists = scope:oe_con_mk_emp }
					add_opinion = {
						target = scope:oe_con_mk_emp
						modifier = oe_con_op_kanhe_tribute
					}
					save_scope_as = oe_con_mk_trib
					scope:oe_con_mk_emp = {
						add_opinion = {
							target = scope:oe_con_mk_trib
							modifier = oe_con_op_kanhe_tribute
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_kanhe_tribute_reassessment_cd years = 5 }
			leader_country ?= {
				change_celestial_authority = { value = -3 }
			}
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 10
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
					num_loans < 2
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_MANDATE_STABLE"
					value = 35
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					NOT = { is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
					exists = scope:recipient.leader_country
					opinion = { target = scope:recipient.leader_country value > 25 }
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_OPINION_EMPEROR"
					value = 30
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 6. Celestial Haijin / Kaihai Maritime Decree (Yes = Kaihai Open Seas, No = Haijin Closed Seas)
oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_EMPEROR"
				value = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:celestial_governor
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_GOV"
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_celestial_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict_cd years = 12 }
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_con_haijin_closed_seas_mod }
					remove_country_modifier = oe_con_haijin_closed_seas_mod
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_kaihai_open_seas_mod
					years = 12
					mode = replace
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.4
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_haijin_kaihai_edict_cd years = 12 }
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_con_kaihai_open_seas_mod }
					remove_country_modifier = oe_con_kaihai_open_seas_mod
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_haijin_closed_seas_mod
					years = 12
					mode = replace
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 5
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						num_of_ports >= 8
						scope:recipient = {
							international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_treasure_hegemony
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_OPEN_SEAS_MARITIME"
					value = 35
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
						num_of_ports < 2
						scope:recipient = {
							international_organization_has_policy = policy:oe_cel_pol_ocean_continental_pivot
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_CLOSED_SEAS_DEFENSE"
					value = -35
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 7. Imperial Frontier Pacification Decree
oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_target_in_tooltip = yes
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:middle_kingdom
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_EMPEROR"
				value = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:celestial_governor
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_GOV"
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_celestial_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_con_select_pacification_target"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_con_no_pacification_target"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = population }
		visible = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_subject = no
			num_locations > 0
			NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient }
			OR = {
				capital ?= { continent = continent:asia }
				any_neighbor_country = {
					is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			OR = {
				NOT = { exists = scope:actor }
				scope:actor ?= {
					NOT = { this = root }
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = root } }
					NOT = { has_truce_with = root }
					NOT = { is_at_war_with = root }
				}
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition }
					"active_resolution(resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition)" ?= {
						"resolution_target(target)" = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition_cd years = 12 }
			leader_country ?= {
				save_scope_as = oe_con_cb_holder
				if = {
					limit = {
						exists = scope:target
						is_rebel_country = no
						oe_cel_is_celestial_emperor = yes
						scope:target = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							num_locations > 0
							NOT = { this = scope:oe_con_cb_holder }
							NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_con_cb_holder }
							NOT = { is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom }
						}
						NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
						NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
						NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:target }
						NOT = { has_truce_with = scope:target }
						NOT = { has_casus_belli_on = scope:target }
					}
					add_casus_belli = {
						target = scope:target
						type = casus_belli:oe_con_cb_celestial_pacification
						years = 10
					}
				}
			}
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_pacification_banner_mod
					years = 8
					mode = replace
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.5
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_imperial_frontier_expedition_cd years = 5 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = -10
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_rival_of = scope:target
							is_enemy_of = scope:target
							AND = {
								is_neighbor_of = scope:target
								opinion = { target = scope:target value < 0 }
							}
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "OE_CON_AI_TARGET_HOSTILE"
						value = 45
					}
				}
				if = {
					limit = {
						is_allied_with = { target = scope:target }
					}
					add = {
						desc = "OE_CON_AI_TARGET_ALLY"
						value = -100
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 8. Charter of the Grand Protectorates
oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote = {
	international_organization_type = middle_kingdom
	show_message = no

	}

			is_rebel_country = no

		}

			international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:middle_kingdom = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:middle_kingdom
					oe_con_mk_has_overseas_or_duhu_subject = yes
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:actor = {
					is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_EMPEROR"
				value = 4
			}
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:celestial_governor
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_CELESTIAL_GOV"
				value = 1
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_celestial_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:middle_kingdom
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote_cd years = 12 }
			leader_country ?= {
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_duhu_charter_subsidy_mod
					years = 12
					mode = replace
				}
				every_subject = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						OR = {
							is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
							is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
						}
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_con_duhu_garrison_mod
						years = 12
						mode = replace
					}
				}
			}
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					is_ai = no
				}
				trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.6
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_grand_duhu_charter_vote_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 10
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
						is_subject_type = oe_cel_grand_duhu
						is_subject_type = oe_cel_xuanweisi
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_DUHU_STAKEHOLDER"
					value = 40
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { is_subject = no }
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_AUTONOMOUS_TRIB"
					value = -15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 9. Congress of Vienna & Constantinople
oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress = {
	international_organization_type = oe_io_eurasian_concert
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
							international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_PENTARCHY"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_concert_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_con_vienna_accord_active years = 15 }
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress_cd years = 15 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_vienna_buffers
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
					add_war_exhaustion = -3
					add_stability = 3
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_con_concert_sovereignty_mod
						years = 15
						mode = replace
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_variable = oe_end_ended }
						add_prestige = 10
					}
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.7
					}
				}
				ordered_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						is_subject = no
						is_hegemon = no
						num_locations > 0
						num_locations <= 25
						capital ?= {
							is_land = yes
							is_passable = yes
							NOT = { is_owned_by_international_organization = scope:recipient }
						}
					}
					order_by = great_power_score
					max = 2
					check_range_bounds = no
					save_scope_as = oe_con_buf_member
					capital ?= {
						save_scope_as = oe_con_buf_cap
						scope:recipient = {
							add_location_to_international_organization = scope:oe_con_buf_cap
						}
					}
					scope:recipient = {
						if = {
							limit = {
								NOT = {
									country_has_special_status = {
										type = special_status:oe_con_neutral_buffer_member
										country = scope:oe_con_buf_member
									}
								}
							}
							international_organization_add_special_status = {
								type = special_status:oe_con_neutral_buffer_member
								country = scope:oe_con_buf_member
							}
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_vienna_constantinople_congress_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						war_exhaustion >= 3
						num_loans >= 2
						has_special_status_in_international_organization = {
							type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
							international_organization = scope:recipient
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_WAR_WEARINESS"
					value = 45
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_heg2_is_multi_hegemon = yes
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_HEGEMON_RESIST"
					value = -40
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 10. Anti-Hegemonic Containment Pact
oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment = {
	international_organization_type = oe_io_eurasian_concert
	show_target_in_tooltip = yes
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment_cd }
				}
				oe_con_any_hegemon_target_exists = yes
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_PENTARCHY"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_concert_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = target
		name = "oe_con_select_hegemon_target"
		none_available_msg_key = "oe_con_no_hegemon_target"
		column = { data = name }
		column = { data = great_power_score }
		visible = {
			oe_con_is_hegemon_containment_target = yes
			OR = {
				NOT = { exists = scope:actor }
				NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				OR = {
					NOT = { resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment }
					"active_resolution(resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment)" ?= {
						"resolution_target(target)" = root
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment_cd years = 12 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_anti_hegemon_cb
			if = {
				limit = {
					exists = scope:target
					scope:target = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
				}
				scope:recipient = {
					every_international_organization_member = {
						limit = {
							is_rebel_country = no
							num_locations > 0
							NOT = { this = scope:target }
							NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:target }
							NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:target } }
						}
						save_scope_as = oe_con_cb_holder
						add_country_modifier = {
							modifier = oe_con_anti_hegemon_league_mod
							years = 10
							mode = replace
						}
						if = {
							limit = {
								is_subject = no
								scope:target = {
									NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:oe_con_cb_holder }
								}
								NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:target }
								NOT = { has_truce_with = scope:target }
								NOT = { has_casus_belli_on = scope:target }
							}
							add_casus_belli = {
								target = scope:target
								type = casus_belli:oe_con_cb_balance_of_power
								years = 10
							}
						}
						if = {
							limit = { is_ai = no }
							trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.8
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_anti_hegemon_containment_cd years = 6 }
		}
		scope:target ?= {
			add_prestige = 10
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 0
		}
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:target }
			scope:actor = {
				if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							this = scope:target
							is_allied_with = { target = scope:target }
							is_subject_of = scope:target
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "OE_CON_AI_IS_TARGET_OR_ALLY"
						value = -150
					}
				}
				else_if = {
					limit = {
						OR = {
							is_rival_of = scope:target
							is_enemy_of = scope:target
							oe_heg2_tension_high = yes
							opinion = { target = scope:target value < 0 }
						}
					}
					add = {
						desc = "OE_CON_AI_CONTAIN_THREAT"
						value = 70
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 11. Global Straits Convention (Yes = Grotius Mare Liberum, No = Selden Mare Clausum)
oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum = {
	international_organization_type = oe_io_eurasian_concert
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum_cd }
				}
				scope:actor ?= {
					OR = {
						num_of_ports > 0
						is_leader_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_PENTARCHY"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_concert_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum_cd years = 15 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_mare_liberum
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_con_mare_clausum_mod }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_con_mare_clausum_mod
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_con_mare_liberum_mod
						years = 15
						mode = replace
					}
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.9
					}
				}
			}
			oe_con_mark_free_strait_ports = yes
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_mare_liberum_clausum_cd years = 15 }
		}
		custom_tooltip = {
			text = oe_con_tt_mare_clausum
			scope:recipient = {
				every_international_organization_member = {
					limit = {
						is_rebel_country = no
						num_locations > 0
					}
					if = {
						limit = { has_country_modifier = oe_con_mare_liberum_mod }
						remove_country_modifier = oe_con_mare_liberum_mod
					}
					add_country_modifier = {
						modifier = oe_con_mare_clausum_mod
						years = 15
						mode = replace
					}
					if = {
						limit = { is_ai = no }
						trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.10
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 5
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						tag = NED
						tag = HOL
						tag = VEN
						tag = GEN
						AND = {
							num_of_ports >= 6
							NOT = { oe_con_controls_major_strait = yes }
						}
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_FREE_SEAS_TRADER"
					value = 40
				}
			}
			if = {
				limit = {
					oe_con_controls_major_strait = yes
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_STRAIT_MONOPOLY"
					value = -35
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}

# 12. International Maritime Sanitary Accord
oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord = {
	international_organization_type = oe_io_eurasian_concert
	show_message = no

	potential = {
		NOT = { oe_con_rule_is_off = yes }
		exists = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor ?= {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
		OR = {
			international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
				resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord
			}
			AND = {
				international_organization:oe_io_eurasian_concert = {
					NOT = { has_variable = oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord_cd }
				}
				oe_con_sanitary_accord_available = yes
			}
		}
	}

	can_vote = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_member_of_international_organization = scope:recipient
		}
	}

	votes = {
		add = {
			desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_BASE"
			value = 1
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:recipient = {
					country_has_special_status = {
						type = special_status:oe_con_pentarchy_seat
						country = scope:actor
					}
				}
			}
			add = {
				desc = "OE_CON_VOTE_PENTARCHY"
				value = 2
			}
		}
	}

	proposal_price = price:oe_con_propose_concert_price
	months = 6
	ai_tick = monthly

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = international_organization
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_international_organization"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {
			international_organization_type = international_organization_type:oe_io_eurasian_concert
		}
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = boolean
		target_flag = vote
		name = "select_vote"
		column = { data = name }
		visible = {}
		enabled = {
			trigger_if = {
				limit = { root = no }
				scope:recipient = {
					resolution_is_active = resolution:oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord
				}
			}
			trigger_else = { always = yes }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		oe_con_bump_passed_counter = yes
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord_cd years = 15 }
			every_international_organization_member = {
				limit = {
					is_rebel_country = no
					num_locations > 0
				}
				add_country_modifier = {
					modifier = oe_con_sanitary_accord_mod
					years = 15
					mode = replace
				}
				if = {
					limit = { is_ai = no }
					trigger_event_non_silently = oe_con.11
				}
			}
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			set_variable = { name = oe_con_res_international_sanitary_accord_cd years = 5 }
		}
		scope:proposer ?= {
			add_prestige = -5
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = {
			desc = "VOTE_BASE_VALUE"
			value = 15
		}
		scope:actor = {
			if = {
				limit = {
					OR = {
						oe_dis_country_infected_any = yes
						oe_dis_neighbor_or_self_infected = yes
						num_of_ports >= 6
					}
				}
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_EPIDEMIC_URGENCY"
					value = 65
				}
			}
			else = {
				add = {
					desc = "OE_CON_AI_LANDLOCKED_SANITARY"
					value = 15
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:proposer
				scope:vote = no
			}
			multiply = {
				desc = "BIAS_FOR_VOTE_AGAINST_IT"
				value = -1
			}
		}
	}

	ai_proposer_risk = {
		value = "scope:actor.currency_utility(prestige|-5)"
	}
}
